response.evidence: Additionally, you can run the tests against a specific browser using the --environment or -e CLI argument. If you don’t have the relevant browser installed, Nightwatch will attempt to set it up for you using Selenium Manager : Terminal window npx nightwatch test/index.ts -e firefox
response.rationale: In the 'Running your NightwatchJS tests' section, the second terminal command is 'npx nightwatch test/index.ts -e firefox', which the artifact explicitly describes as running the tests against a specific browser via the --environment or -e CLI argument. It does not install a browser (that is only a fallback via Selenium Manager) and opening the HTML report is the third command (--open).
